title: Create filter unit tests for HPF mid bell and input trim
description:
Create tests/FilterTests.cpp using the juce::UnitTest console runner (no third-party test frameworks) and register the new DSP sources plus the test file in CMakeLists.txt so the test target builds and runs under CTest.

Requirements:
- tests/FilterTests.cpp defines juce::UnitTest-derived cases that verify:
  * TightFilter frequency response: high-pass attenuation below tight_cut and unity above; the Q=1.2 Precision Tight mode shows the ~+1.8 dB resonant overshoot at cutoff while Q=0.707 does not.
  * MidVoicingFilter mid-bell peaking curve: gain boost peaks near mid_freq with fixed Q_m=0.9, up to +9 dB.
  * InputTrimStage attenuation: measured output gain matches Gin = 10^(trim/20) within tolerance for representative trim values.
- Because acceptance asserts numeric response/gain matching, the tests must measure actual filter output (e.g. via sine probes / impulse response magnitude) and assert against the analytic expected values, not merely compile.
- Update CMakeLists.txt to: add Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.cpp, and Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.cpp to the appropriate targets, and add/extend the ShredBoostTests console-runner target that compiles tests/FilterTests.cpp and is registered with add_test/CTest.
- Do not modify the DSP source files themselves in this task.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/TightFilter.h, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.h, Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.h (public APIs produced by c.1, c.2, c.3)
- CMakeLists.txt (existing target definitions and any test target scaffolding from earlier phases)
- JUCE/modules/juce_core for juce::UnitTest and juce::UnitTestRunner (read only; never modify anything under JUCE/)

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/FilterTests.cpp exists and defines juce::UnitTest cases for TightFilter, MidVoicingFilter, and InputTrimStage using only the juce::UnitTest console runner

The tests measure actual filter/stage output and assert TightFilter's ~+1.8 dB Q=1.2 overshoot, MidVoicingFilter's +9 dB mid-bell peak at mid_freq, and InputTrimStage output matching Gin = 10^(trim/20) within tolerance
CMakeLists.txt registers Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.cpp, and Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.cpp and defines/extends the ShredBoostTests target with add_test/CTest
cmake --build build --target ShredBoostTests builds the test runner without errors
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/TightFilter.h, Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.h, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.cpp, Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.h, or Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.cpp
change product identity metadata (name, vendor, codes, bundle id, LV2 URI)

allowed: choose sine-probe or impulse-response measurement approach for assertions
extend an existing test target or add a dedicated ShredBoostTests target
forbidden: introduce Catch2, GoogleTest, or any non-JUCE test framework
modify the DSP implementation files to make tests pass
